name: bragproof
description: Reads a coding agent's session log and lists what the diff does not show: checks skipped, keys opened, code brought in.

scripts.check: biome lint . && tsc --noEmit && bun run build && bun test
scripts.deploy:preview: SITE_ORIGIN=${PREVIEW_ORIGIN:?set PREVIEW_ORIGIN to the https address of the preview worker} OUT_DIR=dist-preview bun src/site/build.ts && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.preview.jsonc
